prompts.prompt: Identify an important global or local issue that you believe does not receive sufficient attention. Why is this issue often overlooked or under-addressed? Analyze possible paths forward and propose a realistic strategy to raise awareness and advance solutions. Finally, evaluate your proposal's potential to create meaningful change, considering its feasibility, limitations, trade-offs, implementation challenges, and possible unintended consequences.

intl_finance.document: Financial guarantee: proof of funds plus a signed Certification of Financial Support, covering the estimated first-year cost of attendance (amount published by International Student and Scholar Advising)
intl_finance.notes: No financial or visa documents are required at the time of application; applicants should not send them until they receive an admissions decision. After the offer and payment of acceptance fees, ISSA opens a file for the visa eligibility document and emails next steps. The guarantee must be no more than 6 months old. The dollar amount and exact documents are on the ISSA site; no fixed date is published on these pages.

notes: The steps-to-apply pages list the application, fee and STARS record as required and say the Activities section and Personal Statement are optional (a Common App essay is accepted as the Personal Statement); they list no supplemental essay. They add that some programs require additional items (check the Application Checklist in MyPennState) and some require recommendations, so program-specific writing (for example honors or direct-admit programs) was not checked. The pages do not state a cycle; treated as current (accessed 2026-10-27). The global.psu.edu page is the University Park view of a campus selector; its date was not confirmed. Fact-check 2026-10-27: changed 'none' to 'required'. The general Penn State application still has no supplemental essay (the Personal Statement is optional and the Common App essay is accepted for it, source 1), but the first-year requirements page (source 4) lists programs with extra written requirements: the Schreyer Honors College (essays and short answers) and the Millennium Scholars Program (essay question responses, not published on the pages read, so not listed). The Schreyer page (source 5) labels these the 2027 Essay Question (800 words maximum) and 2027 Short Answer Questions (8 required and 1 optional, 200-word limit each).
